mechanism: Foscarnet can cause nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia); famotidine may reduce gastric acid-dependent absorption of minerals and both drugs can affect renal function and mineral homeostasis.
action: Monitor renal function, serum electrolytes (calcium, magnesium, phosphate), and mineral supplementation closely; maintain adequate hydration during foscarnet therapy; consider alternative gastroprotection if possible.
